csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using System.Linq; public class Script { public static void Main() { var all = Object.FindObjectsByType<GameObject>(FindObjectsInactive.Include, FindObjectsSortMode.None); var roads = all.Where(go => go.name.StartsWith("Road_")).ToList(); Debug.Log("Road objects: " + roads.Count); foreach (var g in roads.OrderBy(r => r.name)) Debug.Log(g.name + " | active=" + g.activeSelf); } }
